title_en: Penthouse for sale 2+1+2 toilets+3 balconies in Zogu i Black at a bargain price
description_en: 1800 euros/m². The apartment is located on the 8th and last residential floor of a well-maintained building with an elevator, has a gross area of ​​139 m² + 35.5 m² veranda, modern furniture, ample spaces, south-west orientation with a free view, surrounded by balconies on all sides, invested with a central aspiration system and terraces insulated with stone wool. It is sold furnished as in the photo and has a regular mortgage document. The price is 280,000 euros, optional and the purchase of a garage + parking post in cash with certificates for 20,000 euros
